heading: Tickets and payments
text:
Your ticketing and payment options for travelling on public transport across Victoria

### myki
Pay using a physical myki card or via Mobile myki (Android only) if you don't want to use your bank card. Support: Full fare and concession Modes: Metropolitan trains, trams and buses V/Line trains (some lines) Buses in inner regional areas

heading: Contactless
text: Pay as you go by tapping your Mastercard or Visa, smartphone or smartwatch. Support: Full fare only Modes: Metropolitan trains, trams and buses V/Line trains (some lines) Buses in inner regional areas Find out more about V/Line tickets

heading: V/Line tickets
text: Buy a paper ticket or eTicket for V/Line coaches, or to reserve a seat on some V/Line trains. Support: Full fare and concession Required for: Seat reservations on some V/Line trains V/Line coaches Feedback Find out more about myki Find out more about contactless

heading: Find out more about fares east
text: Public transport is half price until 1 January 2027, and the prices below reflect this discount. Once you hit the cap, travel is free for the rest of the day. Weekday cap: $5.70 full fare | $2.85 concession Weekend cap: $4.00 full fare | $2.00 concession | Seniors free Until you reach the cap, how much you pay depends on how far you travel.

heading: Cheaper travel before 7am - Early bird
text: Your metropolitan train journey is free if you tap on and off before 7.15am on weekdays. You get the free early bird fare when you: travel on a metropolitan train, or a V/Line service between Pakenham or Sunbury and Melbourne keep a positive account balance tap on and off within 2 hours, before 7.15am on a weekday. To make sure you get the early bird fare, use train services that arrive at your destination by 7am.

heading: Cheaper travel after 6pm
text:
If you tap on after 6pm, you can travel until 3am the next day. This gives you up to 9 hours of travel for the price of 2 hours. Feedback

### Weekend and public holiday fares
On weekends and public holidays, your daily fare is capped at $4.00 for full fare, $2.00 for concession, and free for Seniors myki holders.
